# MDSi, Inc.

MDSi, Inc. is a IT Services and IT Consulting company. MDSI delivers secure, scalable IT solutions and lifecycle services that optimize performance, reduce costs, and support business growth. MDSi, Inc. employs 217 people (+3.8% YoY, +8 people) and has an annual revenue of $4.4M, founded in 1990. Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia, United States, with offices in MDSi - Tampa and Allentown. Its workforce is distributed across United States, United Kingdom, France, and Oman.

## About

MDSI is the IT solutions partner of choice for some of the world’s largest, most trusted service providers and enterprises. We specialize in professional services, technology acquisition and integration, and supply chain logistics.
